lessons.title: Bounded topology and tracial representations
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Arbitrary-net bounded representation transport, faithful-state representations and semifinite tracial representations, with five solved exercises. The two companions supply positive-functional normality, arbitrary projection joins and exact half-closed threshold cuts. Full Borel and modular theory have separate scope.

lessons.title: Finite free actions and exact coboundaries
Dividing type-II projections and constructing matrix units
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The finite-division and matrix-unit arguments are supplied here at arbitrary Hilbert-space dimension and center. Hilbert-space completeness, spectral calculus, polar decomposition and Zorn’s lemma remain stated foundations. The trace corollary additionally uses the general center-valued trace foundation identified in the finite-action lesson.

lessons.title: The simple outer group of the hyperfinite factor
lessons.prerequisite_notice: This draft supplies the local subgroup argument, explicit periodic matrix pair and tracial product construction. Its classification, tensor-absorption and hyperfinite-uniqueness prerequisites are not all proved in this selection. The simplicity proof is conditional on the exact preceding results stated in the lesson.

lessons.title: From approximate cocycles to exact coboundaries
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The fixed-coordinate diagonal and finite tower estimates are proved here. The locally finite consequence uses the included finite free-action theorem. The final compatibility application and transitive operator-algebra foundations retain their stated programme prerequisites. This lesson does not derive general amenable projection existence from Følner sets alone.

lessons.title: Correcting approximate relative towers
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The corner correction, weighted boundary bounds and their conditional conversion to an exact coboundary are proved here. Polar and spectral foundations and

lessons.title: Cyclic towers in finite algebras
lessons.prerequisite_notice: This draft includes the discrete approximate-eigenvector argument, Gram correction, trace budget and probability-algebra tower proof. The general dual-center theorem has an exact earlier programme proof outside this selection; its integrability and spectral hypotheses are additional prerequisites. Nonfactor and nonseparable-predual scope is retained.

lessons.title: Cyclic finite models for outer conjugacy
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The general-factor close-projection lemma, finite-partition repair and Borel normalization are proved here, including infinite projections. The implementer and matrix tensor-absorption lessons are included.

lessons.title: Amenable actions and tensor absorption
lessons.prerequisite_notice: This draft proves the Bernoulli-model absorption, onto normal isomorphism, genuine cocycle, semifinite trace equality and chosen inner phases under its stated centralizer and approximation foundations. It supplies the fixed-coordinate diagonal, finite-head flip, central-kernel, tensor-factor and globally normal inverse arguments.

lessons.title: Almost invariant inner implementers
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The central-defect correction, predual transport and paired-coordinate ordinary subsequence hold for arbitrary separable-predual factors and every fixed integer power. The central-tower lesson and faithful-state topology proofs are included.

lessons.title: Central towers and unitary cocycles
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The invariant-corner, relative tower and prescribed-cocycle arguments retain every separable-predual factor and arbitrary free ultrafilter. The finite tower, projection and example-specific modular foundations retain their stated transitive obligations.

lessons.title: Matrix eigenvectors and tensor absorption
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The no-finite-type-I-summand matrix lemma, unit-circle phase condition and original-action small-perturbation statement are supplied. The centralizer and strong-stability providers use the stated infinite-product, finite AFD, projection and finite-action foundations. TF0–TF4 supply normal-functional and specified tracial product interfaces; broader tensor foundations have separate scope. The tensor companion TF5–TF6 supplies normal homomorphism and completely positive tensor maps in arbitrary faithful normal representations; the ambient summable-splitting and classification hypotheses retain their stated scope.

lessons.title: Comparing asymptotically aperiodic automorphisms
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Strongly stable separable-factor comparison with seven induction conditions, prescribed tests and one small perturbation in the original state, followed by six solved exercises. The tensor, spectral, quotient and finite-action foundations are explicit. TF0–TF4 supply normal-functional and specified tracial product interfaces. The tensor companion TF5–TF6 supplies normal homomorphism and completely positive tensor maps in arbitrary faithful normal representations; the ambient summable-splitting and classification hypotheses retain their stated scope.

lessons.title: Classifying finite cyclic automorphisms
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Finite cyclic classification for factors, with cyclic extraction, the identity tensor leg and period/phase invariants for every period. A counterexample explains the factor hypothesis. Five solved exercises and the exact-Weyl proof accompany the classification. TF0–TF4 supply normal-functional and specified tracial product interfaces; broader tensor foundations have separate scope. The tensor companion TF5–TF6 supplies normal homomorphism and completely positive tensor maps in arbitrary faithful normal representations; the ambient summable-splitting and classification hypotheses retain their stated scope.

lessons.title: Exact implementers for cyclic actions
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Finite-order implementation and genuine conjugacy for strongly stable separable factors at every period, with five solved exercises. The uniform spectral-cut, fixed-factor polar and matching-coordinate arguments are supplied. General standard-form, trace, Borel and tensor foundations remain explicit.

lessons.title: Exact Weyl pairs for cyclic actions
lessons.prerequisite_notice: One fixed shift for the entire finite-order implementing sequence, with every factor type and a prescribed faithful-state tolerance. The proof includes equivalence between the two finite partitions. Standard-form, factor trace/dimension and other transitive foundations remain explicit.

lessons.title: Central sequences and the module circle
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Central-sequence reduction and the split module sequence for type III-lambda factors, with six solved exercises. The period comparison assumes equal periods; a counterexample explains that hypothesis. General modular, continuous-core, spectral and classification foundations remain separate prerequisites.

lessons.title: Central triviality and modular powers
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The centrally trivial converse, modular return and scalar phase for hyperfinite type III-lambda factors, with seven solved exercises. A specified discrete suspension supplies the real-cohomology application. General modular/core, operator-valued-weight, measurable-field and classification foundations remain explicit.

lessons.title: Trace scaling on the hyperfinite semifinite factor
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Multiplier classification and the general type-I centralizer, with five solved exercises. The companion supplies the discrete stability argument. General weight, trace, tensor and classification foundations remain explicit.

lessons.title: Centrally trivial automorphisms and core normalizers
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The type III-zero equality and every-faithful-state cocycle formulation include eight solved exercises. Partial orbit maps give lacunary normalization. Measurable phase witnesses and the nonsingular tower force the variable coefficient action to be inner, and a real-coordinate slab gives its core implementer. The constant-field argument is retained as a conditional alternative.

lessons.title: Permutation symmetry and Powers factors
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The product construction, modular eigenbasis, factorial centralizer, diagonal expectation and flip action are developed here. The companion proves crossed-product recognition, factorial-centralizer spectra, norm-one projections, invariant-state finite classification and its tracial quotient and expectation foundations. The modular, standard-pair, bidual, tensor and trace-scaling foundations retain their stated scope. The tensor companion TF5–TF6 supplies normal homomorphism and completely positive tensor maps in arbitrary faithful normal representations; the ambient summable-splitting and classification hypotheses retain their stated scope.

lessons.title: Powers subfactors from periodic states
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The construction preserves the specified periodic state and its complete modular action on an arbitrary separable type III-lambda ambient factor. The periodic-state, corner and normal-GNS proofs are linked explicitly. General modular and spectral foundations retain their stated hypotheses;

lessons.title: Making towers commute with a fixed cocycle
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Finite-partition reindexing preserves every trace and specified covariance norm for arbitrary induced countable-group actions. Weighted errors and the fixed-cocycle diagonal give a conditional cohomology criterion. The Gaussian projection theorem supplies that criterion for faithful induced countable amenable actions;

lessons.title: Free actions after fixing coefficients
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Relative coefficient-intertwiner freeness for every nontrivial induced countable-group element; finite-group unitary cocycle correction in an arbitrary finite coefficient commutant with its faithful invariant trace. The central trace comparison and crossed-product proofs are included.

lessons.title: Inner approximations compatible with characteristic data
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Simultaneous approximation of trace-preserving comparison automorphisms and prescribed compatible cocycles for countable amenable actions on the hyperfinite semifinite factor. The arbitrary-factor conditional theorem and abelian character correction retain full scope. Fixed-ultrafilter and moving-multiplier arguments are explicit;

lessons.title: Gluing comparisons of isotropy actions
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Gluing of actual phase-compatible isotropy comparisons over a supplied finite Borel exhaustion. The unitary cocycle, trace gauge and chosen inner implementers are retained. Predual completeness and finite gluing are proved here; initial isotropy classification, construction of compatible phases and

lessons.title: Models with prescribed characteristic data
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Characteristic models for countable amenable groups with prescribed actual multiplication and transport phases, exact inner subgroup and arbitrary permitted trace modulus. Borel field transport uses supplied enumerations and a multiplicative principal section. General initial comparison, universal defect realization, fixed-factor Borel trivialization and

lessons.title: Aligning traces and inner phases
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Explicit inverse-character and coherent trace corrections of supplied genuine isotropy comparisons, preserving chosen inner implementers and a prescribed positive trace gauge. Full Borel cochain witnesses and the existing gluing hypotheses are retained. Initial amenable comparison, field trivialization and

lessons.title: Scalar defects and hyperfinite gluing
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Exact scalar correction on a supplied increasing finite Borel relation, including descent from matched inner isotropy. General initial comparison and outer isotropy have separate scope;

lessons.title: Unitary two-cocycles and approximate action comparison
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Unitary correction on principal relations and the asymptotic centralizer, with pointwise approximate comparison on the original factor. Exact original-factor cocycles are supplied by the subsequent near-identity lesson.

lessons.title: Controlled amenable cohomology and finite inner comparisons
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Exact unitary lifts for finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, controlled finite coboundaries and finite inner comparisons. Convergent two-sided conjugacy has separate scope;

lessons.title: Near-identity two-cocycle correction on the original factor
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Quantitative two-cocycle correction inside a finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factor, exact coordinate cocycles and genuine approximate comparisons, under the stated induced-action and foundational hypotheses.

lessons.title: Two-sided convergence and transported cocycle limits
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Two-sided convergence of automorphisms and transported cocycles, including the one-sided shift obstruction.

lessons.title: Uniform towers and genuine cocycle stabilization
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Uniform tower correction and genuine cocycle stabilization for finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, with separate nontracial state estimates.

lessons.title: Generator tests for cocycle stabilization
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Generator and prefix-functional tests for finite cocycle stabilization, with quotient and original-factor laws distinguished.

lessons.title: Alternating comparisons with convergent cocycles
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The classical alternating comparison for centrally nontrivial amenable actions on finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, under the stated foundations. Nontrivial inner isotropy and measured-field classification have additional scope.

lessons.title: Quotient comparison with matched inner phases
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Approximate original-factor comparisons and a genuine ultrapower cocycle with prescribed inner-subgroup values.

lessons.title: Quotient associators and reconstruction of comparisons
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The quotient scalar associator, exact reconstruction, a common-coboundary comparison and the approximate joint input for general associators.

lessons.title: Joint quotient comparisons with a common associator
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Simultaneous comparison of quotient maps and actual coefficients with a common scalar associator, followed by a genuine full-group cocycle.

lessons.title: Choosing and gluing measurable action comparisons
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Completed-measure selection, invariant Borel reduction and exact gluing on a supplied constant hyperfinite semifinite field with a finite orbit exhaustion.

lessons.title: Characteristic classification of semifinite actions
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Countable semifinite action classification and measured constant-field comparison from the full moving characteristic class and compatible trace multiplier.

lessons.title: Reconstructing continuous comparisons from return arrows
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Exact reconstruction from labelled return arrows for varying separable factor fields, with semifinite characteristic comparison and trace normalization under the stated foundations.

lessons.title: From global characteristic invariants to return data
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The global characteristic criterion for integer–real actions, including properly ergodic, free transitive and periodic transitive centres, under the stated factor and measured-relation foundations.

lessons.title: Comparing trace-scaling flows over their centres
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Trace-normalized comparison of two real actions with the same properly ergodic centre flow, exact scalar-phase correction and a spatial crossed-product isomorphism; the type III-zero application retains its stated core, uniformity and foundational prerequisites.

lessons.title: Realizing flows with skew odometers
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Five-digit realization of a prescribed properly ergodic real flow, its invariant coordinate, compatible matrix approximation and abelian crossed-product model; seven solved exercises.

lessons.title: Inner approximations compatible with a crossed product
lessons.navigation_label: Inner approximations and the module kernel
lessons.prerequisite_notice: The module kernel for approximately finite type III-zero factors: nonfactor coefficient approximation, central coboundaries, return normalization and canonical-extension continuity; eight solved exercises.

lessons.title: Lifting flow symmetries to factor automorphisms
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Continuous homomorphic sections of the module map for approximately finite type III-zero factors, derivative compensation, real crossed-product duality and a Pell central-unitary example; eight solved exercises.

lessons.title: Common gauge invariants and outer conjugacy
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Common-gauge invariants for automorphisms of approximately finite type III-zero factors, the exact kernel of the separate-class projection, a realized sign obstruction and conditional outer-conjugacy classification with normal crossed-product descent; eight solved exercises.

lessons.title: Classifying modular cyclic returns
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Outer conjugacy for the hyperfinite type III-lambda factor, under the stated generalized-trace, centrally trivial, finite-model and semifinite-comparison foundations. The lesson computes the inner-return lattice and its characters, proves the normal cocycle lift and gives seven solved exercises.

lessons.title: Periodic cocycles and the characteristic square
lessons.prerequisite_notice: Periodic cocycles, their explicit core realizers, all six characteristic-square kernels, cyclic return phases and the tensor modular-action calculation; seven solved exercises. Core analytic proofs are included at their stated foundations. The classification consequence additionally requires the separate modular cyclic-return comparison.

companions.title: Proof companion: bounded topology and faithful states
companions.prerequisite_notice: Complete selected earlier programme arguments for the bounded representation and faithful-state branch, at the stated scalar, Hilbert and set-theoretic entry assumptions. General weights and modular theory are separate prerequisites.

companions.title: Proof companion: normal functionals and tracial representations
companions.prerequisite_notice: Positive-functional normality, arbitrary projection joins and exact threshold cuts, with arbitrary directed nets and Hilbert cardinality. The companion identifies the earlier programme proofs and their assumptions.

companions.title: Proof companion: normal tensor tests and tracial products
companions.prerequisite_notice: Normal product functionals at arbitrary Hilbert cardinality; faithful countable tracial products and compatible GNS identifications; normal tensor homomorphisms with exact kernels and ranges; normal completely positive dilations and tensor maps, and predual limits of tensor automorphisms.

companions.title: Proof companion: removing a discrete trace-scaling cocycle
companions.prerequisite_notice: The discrete counting and Fourier argument treats every specified unitary in a semifinite algebra with separable predual, including nonfactors. Trace existence and central averaging supplies T1. The extended-positive and spectral, density and modular-transfer inputs W1–W3 are stated separately.

companions.title: Proof companion: dual fixed points, core commutants and central cocycles
companions.prerequisite_notice: Full supplied proofs retain arbitrary-algebra scope, the specified cocycle and every faithful-state chart. The general standard-form, KMS, dual-weight conjugation, core-chart, spectral and harmonic-analysis inputs remain explicit.

companions.title: Trace existence and central averaging
companions.prerequisite_notice: Finite center-valued traces, normal corner-trace extension, semifinite scalar traces and simultaneous norm averaging, with arbitrary centers, Hilbert dimensions and increasing nets. The accompanying bounded-topology and tracial-normality proofs supply the stated analytic foundations.

companions.title: Crossed-product recognition and injective cores
companions.prerequisite_notice: Crossed-product recognition, corners, trace normalization, factorial-centralizer spectra and the injective type III-lambda reduction. PC9–PC11 prove norm-one retractions, invariant-state finite classification and its tracial foundations. TF2–TF3 and TF5–TF6 supply the tracial product identification and general normal tensor maps. Modular-weight, bidual and standard-pair foundations retain their stated scope.
